_comment: Curated registry of sequence-to-function (S2F) models. This is the one file
maintained by hand; everything in data/ is generated from it.
Identity
id         - stable slug; never change once published (URLs and history key on it).
class      - core | derivative | dna-lm | splicing | mpra. Only core and
derivative show by default; the rest sit behind the gray-zone toggle.
parent     - id of the model this one was built from (architecture or weights),
or null. Drives the lineage view. Must name another id in this file.
year       - year of first public release (preprint counts).
papers     - EVERY version of the model paper (preprint AND journal). Citing works
are unioned across versions and deduped by OpenAlex work id. Pin
openalex_id when a title search cannot find a version.
Where it lives (all optional; null or [] when absent)
github      - owner/repo of the model's own code.
github_also - extra repos for the same model (an API client beside research
code). Their stars are summed into usage; runnability reads `github` only.
github_path - set when the code is one folder of a shared monorepo
(deepmind-research, calico/basenji for Akita). The pipeline then
does NOT credit the repo's stars or issues to this model.
hf          - Hugging Face model ids for the weights.
weights     - other weight hosts: {host: kaggle|zenodo|gcs|api|website, id|url}.
Kaggle and Zenodo report downloads; the others are recorded only.
pypi        - PyPI package, only where auto-detection cannot confirm the link-back.
Access
access  - open | non-commercial | gated | api-only | none.
license - SPDX id of the code license where known; otherwise a short slug
(academic-research-only, Genentech-Non-Commercial-1.0). 'access' is the
judgement the score uses; 'license' is the evidence for it.
Shape of the model (what the genome-browser view draws)
context_bp    - bp of DNA read per prediction (the right end of the track bar).
output        - track (binned profile) | window (one value per input) |
gene (one value per gene) | contact_map | embedding.
resolution_bp - output bin size in bp (left end of the bar). For window and gene
outputs leave null: the view draws a diamond at context_bp.
n_tracks      - number of output tracks/targets, if the paper states it.
readouts      - accessibility | tf_binding | histone | cage | tss | rna_seq |
expression | splicing | polyadenylation | contacts | mpra.
Empty for DNA language models (embeddings only).
species       - species the released weights predict for (or 'multi').
Leave a field null rather than guessing - nulls render as 'not reported'.

models.name: Cherimoya
models.notes: Compact ChromBPNet-derived model. CATv1 provides human chromatin-accessibility models; the architecture can also be trained on other sequencing readouts. A formal preprint is forthcoming.

models.name: DeepBind

papers.title: Predicting the sequence specificities of DNA- and RNA-binding proteins by deep learning

models.notes: One small CNN per protein, trained on PBM, SELEX and ChIP-seq. The root of sequence-to-binding deep learning.

models.name: DeepSEA

papers.title: Predicting effects of noncoding variants with deep learning-based sequence model

models.notes: First deep CNN to predict chromatin effects of noncoding variants from sequence alone.

models.name: Basset

papers.title: Basset: learning the regulatory code of the accessible genome with deep convolutional neural networks

models.notes: DNase hypersensitivity across 164 cell types; the start of the Kelley lineage.

models.name: Basenji

papers.title: Sequential regulatory activity prediction across chromosomes with convolutional neural networks

models.notes: Dilated convolutions reach 131 kb and predict coverage in 128 bp bins.

models.name: ExPecto

papers.title: Deep learning sequence-based ab initio prediction of variant effects on expression and disease risk

models.notes: Spatially pools DeepSEA-style chromatin features across 40 kb around the TSS to predict tissue expression. The repository ships no licence file.

models.name: Xpresso

papers.title: Predicting mRNA Abundance Directly from Genomic Sequence Using Deep Convolutional Neural Networks

models.notes: Predicts steady-state mRNA level per gene from 10.5 kb around the TSS plus mRNA half-life features.

models.name: Basenji2

papers.title: Cross-species regulatory sequence activity prediction

models.notes: Joint human and mouse training; its 5,313 human + 1,643 mouse targets became Enformer's training set.

models.name: Akita

papers.title: Predicting 3D genome folding from DNA sequence with Akita

models.notes: Predicts Hi-C and Micro-C contact maps over ~1 Mb at 2 kb resolution.

models.name: Enformer

papers.title: Effective gene expression prediction from sequence by integrating long-range interactions

training_data.stage: Supervised human and mouse training, followed by human fine-tuning
training_data.summary: Human and mouse reference sequences paired with chromatin and transcription measurements from the Basenji2 dataset.
training_data.sources: Basenji2 dataset; ENCODE, Roadmap Epigenomics and FANTOM
training_data.assays: TF and histone ChIP-seq, DNase-seq, ATAC-seq and CAGE
training_data.coverage: Human and mouse genomes; multiple tissues and cell types.
training_data.size: 34,021 human and 29,295 mouse training sequence examples; 5,313 human and 1,643 mouse assay tracks.
training_data.split: Separate training, validation and test genomic sequences; the paper reports 2,213 human and 2,209 mouse validation examples, and 1,937 human and 2,017 mouse test examples.
training_data.overlap: Benchmark-specific overlap has not been assessed.

models.notes: Adds transformer attention to reach distal enhancers; the default baseline for most later work. The Hugging Face id is the PyTorch port of the official weights (enformer-pytorch).

models.name: BPNet
models.org: Kundaje Lab, Stanford / Zeitlinger Lab, Stowers

papers.title: Base-resolution models of transcription-factor binding reveal soft motif syntax

training_data.stage: Supervised training on transcription factor binding profiles
training_data.summary: Mouse embryonic stem cell DNA sequences paired with base-resolution binding profiles for four pluripotency transcription factors.
training_data.sources: ChIP-nexus experiments generated by the authors
training_data.assays: ChIP-nexus for Oct4, Sox2, Nanog and Klf4
training_data.size: Four transcription factors; total training sequence count has not been curated.
training_data.split: Training, hyperparameter tuning and evaluation used genomic regions on distinct chromosomes.
training_data.overlap: Benchmark-specific overlap has not been assessed.

models.notes: Base-resolution ChIP-nexus profiles of pluripotency TFs; built to read motif syntax.

models.name: Sei

papers.title: A sequence-based global map of regulatory activity for deciphering human genetics

models.notes: Groups 21,907 chromatin profiles into 40 sequence classes for variant interpretation.

models.name: Orca

papers.title: Sequence-based modeling of three-dimensional genome architecture from kilobase to chromosome scale

models.notes: Multiscale 3D genome prediction from 1 Mb up to 256 Mb windows.

models.name: scBasset

papers.title: scBasset: sequence-based modeling of single-cell ATAC-seq using convolutional neural networks

models.notes: Predicts single-cell ATAC accessibility in every cell from the peak sequence.

models.name: Borzoi

papers.title: Predicting RNA-seq coverage from DNA sequence as a unifying model of gene regulation

training_data.stage: Supervised training on genomic assay tracks
training_data.summary: Human and mouse genomic sequences paired with RNA-seq coverage and other functional genomics tracks.
training_data.coverage: Human and mouse; diverse biosamples including cell lines, adult human tissues and developing mice.
training_data.size: The RNA-seq component includes 866 human and 279 mouse ENCODE datasets; these are not counts of all training tracks or sequence examples.
training_data.split: Four genomic cross-validation folds; training, validation and test intervals vary by fold.
training_data.overlap: Benchmark-specific overlap has not been assessed.

models.notes: Predicts RNA-seq coverage at 32 bp, so one model covers transcription, splicing and polyadenylation. The Hugging Face ids are the PyTorch port of the official weights (johahi/borzoi-pytorch).

models.name: Puffin

papers.title: Sequence basis of transcription initiation in the human genome

models.notes: Interpretable model of transcription initiation built from a small set of learned motifs and their position effects.

models.name: ChromBPNet

papers.title: ChromBPNet: bias factorized, base-resolution deep learning models of chromatin accessibility reveal cis-regulatory sequence syntax, transcription factor footprints and regulatory variants

models.notes: Base-resolution ATAC/DNase profiles with the enzyme sequence bias modelled out by a separate network.

models.name: Flashzoi

papers.title: Flashzoi: an enhanced Borzoi for accelerated genomic analysis

models.notes: Borzoi retrained with rotary embeddings and FlashAttention for faster inference.

models.name: scooby

papers.title: scooby: modeling multimodal genomic profiles from DNA sequence at single-cell resolution

models.notes: Fine-tunes Borzoi to predict single-cell RNA and ATAC coverage per cell from sequence. PyPI's 'scooby' is an unrelated package; the link-back check rejects it.

models.name: Decima

papers.title: Decoding sequence determinants of gene expression in diverse cellular and disease states

models.notes: Fine-tunes Borzoi on single-cell pseudobulk data to predict cell-type-specific gene expression.

models.name: AlphaGenome

papers.title: Advancing regulatory variant effect prediction with AlphaGenome

training_data.stage: Supervised training on functional genomics measurements
training_data.summary: Human and mouse reference sequences paired with molecular readouts across many tissues and cell types.
training_data.assays: RNA-seq, CAGE, PRO-cap, DNase-seq, ATAC-seq, TF and histone ChIP-seq, and genomic contact maps
training_data.coverage: Human and mouse; hundreds of cell types and tissues.
training_data.size: A single total for training examples or assay datasets has not been curated; the authors report hundreds of cell types and tissues.
training_data.split: Four genomic cross-validation folds; fold-specific models use held-out intervals for validation and testing. The all-folds model uses all folds.
training_data.overlap: Benchmark-specific overlap has not been assessed; check the model version and fold for each evaluation.

references.label: AlphaGenome model card and training data

models.notes: Reads 1 Mb at base resolution across every major readout, including splice junctions and contact maps. Served through an API; weights released in 2026 behind a gated Hugging Face licence.

models.name: SpliceAI

papers.title: Predicting Splicing from Primary Sequence with Deep Learning

models.notes: Calls splice donors and acceptors at single-base resolution from 10 kb of flanking sequence. Repository archived by Illumina; models are CC BY-NC 4.0.

models.name: Pangolin

papers.title: Predicting RNA splicing from DNA sequence using Pangolin

models.notes: SpliceAI-style architecture trained on splice-site usage across four species and tissues.

models.name: Malinois
models.org: Sabeti Lab, Broad / Tewhey Lab, JAX

papers.title: Machine-guided design of cell-type-targeting cis-regulatory elements

models.notes: Predicts MPRA activity in K562, HepG2 and SK-N-SH; used to design cell-type-specific synthetic enhancers.

models.name: DNABERT

papers.title: DNABERT: pre-trained Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers model for DNA-language in genome

models.notes: BERT over overlapping k-mers of the human genome; the first widely used DNA language model.

models.name: DNABERT-2

papers.title: DNABERT-2: Efficient Foundation Model and Benchmark For Multi-Species Genome

models.notes: Replaces k-mers with byte-pair tokens and trains across 135 species.

models.name: Nucleotide Transformer

papers.title: The Nucleotide Transformer: Building and Evaluating Robust Foundation Models for Human Genomics

models.notes: Masked language models over 6-mer tokens, up to 2.5B parameters, pretrained on 850 genomes.

models.name: HyenaDNA

papers.title: HyenaDNA: Long-Range Genomic Sequence Modeling at Single Nucleotide Resolution
HyenaDNA: Long-Range Genomic Sequence Modeling at Single Nucleotide Resolution

models.notes: Long-convolution language model with single-nucleotide tokens over up to 1 Mb.

models.name: Caduceus

papers.title: Caduceus: Bi-Directional Equivariant Long-Range DNA Sequence Modeling

models.notes: Bidirectional, reverse-complement-equivariant Mamba language model over 131 kb.

models.name: GPN-MSA

papers.title: A DNA language model based on multispecies alignment predicts the effects of genome-wide variants

models.notes: Language model over a 100-vertebrate alignment; scores variant effects zero-shot.

models.name: Evo 2

papers.title: Genome modeling and design across all domains of life with Evo 2

models.notes: StripedHyena 2 language model (7B and 40B) trained on genomes from all domains of life.
